title: India needs a new party....
description:
Checkout Odoo Accounting - https://www.odoo.com/r/optE

BJP, Congress, regional parties—different flags, same playbook. Freebies to buy votes, caste arithmetic to win elections, and religious divide to keep people busy while real issues are ignored. Despite loud ideological claims, almost every Indian party today follows a core left-wing socialist mindset—big promises, bigger subsidies, and zero accountability.

Development takes a back seat while populism rules. Merit is punished, productivity is taxed, and the middle class keeps paying the bill.

In this video, we argue why India doesn’t just need a new government—it needs a new political party with fresh thinking, economic realism, and long-term vision.

Watch till the end if you’re tired of choosing the “lesser evil.”
